title: Binary transformation groups and topological fields
summary: The notion of a semitransitive binary action of a group $G$ on a topological space is introduced. A duality theorem is proved, establishing a bijective correspondence between semitransitive distributive binary $G$-spaces and topological fields whose multiplicative group is isomorphic to $G$. This result yields an equivalence between the category of semitransitive distributive binary $G$-spaces and the category of topological fields with multiplicative group $G$.
